title.narrative: Personalbidrag till Osses civila observatörsinsats i Ukraina, OSCE SMM Ukraina
Personnel to the OSCE Special Monitoring Mission to Ukraine, OSCE SMM

description.narrative: Polismyndighetens personal ska bidra till genomförandet av insatsens uppdrag.
That the Swedish Police personnel contributes to fulfill the mission's mandate.

Polismyndigheten har, enligt förordning (1999:1155) om Polisens utlandsstyrka samt årliga regleringsbrev, i uppdrag från Regeringen att rekrytera och ställa personal till förfogande för internationell civil krishantering inom ramen för bl. a. Förenta Nationernas (FN:s), Europeiska unionens (EU:s),och Organisationen för säkerhet och samarbete i Europas (Osses) freds och säkerhetsfrämjande insatser. Osses civila observatörsinsats i Ukraina (Osse Special Monitoring Mission in Ukraine, OSCE SMM) utgör en av dessa insatser.

The Swedish Police Authority has been assigned by the government, through the ordinance on police peace support (1999:1155) and yearly regulation letters, to recruit and make personnel available for international civilian crisis management and peace support operations under the auspices of the United Nations (UN), the European Union (EU), the Organisation for Security and Cooperation i Europe (OSCE) or similar organisations. The OSCE Special monitoring mission to Ukraine (OSCE SMM) is one of the operations to which the Swedish Police Authority contributes with personnel.

sector.narrative: Civilian peace-building, conflict prevention and resolution

description.narrative: Missionen avslutades under 2022. Därför fanns inga svenska poliser sekonderade till missionen under 2023 - enbart några kvarvarande betalningar gjordes. Under 2022 tjänstgjorde 2 svenska polisanställda (2 kvinnor) i instsen tills den avslutades i mars 2022. En av de sekonderasde bistod även i nedmonteringen av insatsen och det svenska polisbidraget motsvarade 1,1 årsarbetskrafter under 2022.

This mission was concluded during 2022 and only remaining disbursements were made in 2023. Thus no personnel from the Swedish police were active in the mission. During 2022, 2 Swedish Police employees were seconded to the mission until the mandate ended in March. One of them further assisted in the mission's closing down work units.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
